segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַמּוֹכֵר אֶת הַבַּיִת – מָכַר אֶת הַדֶּלֶת, אֲבָל לֹא אֶת הַמַּפְתֵּחַ; מָכַר אֶת הַמַּכְתֶּשֶׁת קְבוּעָה, אֲבָל לֹא אֶת הַמִּיטַּלְטֶלֶת; מָכַר אֶת הָאִיצְטְרוֹבֵיל, אֲבָל לֹא אֶת הַקֶּלֶת; וְלֹא אֶת הַתַּנּוּר וְלֹא אֶת הַכִּירַיִם. בִּזְמַן שֶׁאָמַר לוֹ: ״הוּא וְכׇל מַה שֶׁבְּתוֹכוֹ״ –
segments.en: «MISHNA:» One «who sells a house has,» as part of the sale, «sold» also «the door, but not the key. He has sold the mortar that is fixed» in the ground, «but not the portable» one. «He has sold the» immovable «lower millstone [ha’itzterobil], but not the» portable «upper stone [hakelet],» the funnel into which one pours the grain to be ground. «And» he has sold «neither the oven nor the double stove,» as they are deemed movable. «When» the seller «says to» the buyer: I am selling you «it, and everything that is in it,»
«all these» components «are sold» as part of the sale of the house.

moves.cueHe: המוכר את הבית – מכר את הדלת
בזמן שאמר לו: הוא וכל מה שבתוכו
moves.summary: with 'it and all within it', all are sold

positions.claim: a house sale includes fixed fittings but not movables, unless he said 'it and everything in it'
